messages:
alex: Quick proposal — runway for a 'chainsaw' sprint to pay down long-tail tech debt across runtime adapters. Goal: remove 3 legacy adapters, consolidate 2 config surfaces, and prune ~15k lines of brittle glue. Plan sketched below. Thoughts?

maya: +1 on removal target. what's the safety net? can we do incremental toggles?

alex: Safety tethers: feature flags per adapter, circuit-breaker fallback to legacy, and canary in prod with traffic steering. We'll keep KV cache compatibility shim for 2 weeks.

sam: Need runbook for rollback. Also who owns DB migrations? we can't block on infra.

jon: I can own migration scripts. propose windows: Tue/Thu 23:00-03:00 UTC for low traffic canaries. ops-bot: deploy schedule shows lower P95 during that window :chart_with_downwards_trend: 

ops-bot: scheduled-maintenance-note: canary window reserved 23:00-03:00 UTC on Tue/Thu. Reminder 24hr before.

maya: Do we have perf benchmarks for new adapter? last spike hit 220ms p50 -> want <180ms.

alex: yes — local bench + sim harness shows 160-170ms for typical seq len 512. Will publish artifacts to the repo under /bench/adapter-rework.

sam: How do we detect user-impact fast? add smoke checks: 5 prompts/sec canary, latency SLA alert on 10% regression, error budget burn alarm.

jon: add query to prod observability: rolling 5m error rate for route=/v1/generate and 99pct latency for tokens. If alert, immediate rollback to legacy flag.

alex: Draft runbook snippet:
```
# Chainsaw sprint runbook
1) Flip feature flag in canary region
2) Run smoke load: 5rps for 10m
3) Check metrics: 99p < 200ms, errors < 0.1%
4) Gradually increase traffic to 20% over 15m
5) If fail -> flip flag -> verify rollback
```

maya: Nice. also add post-mortem checklist and owner for each adapter removal (tagging in PRs).

sam: I'll prep migration PRs and smoke tests. can we get a small budget for extra infra during spike?

alex: yes I'll raise request to finance for temporary capacity. Expected ~2-3 reserved GPUs for 24hr during cutover.

jon: one more ask: keep a compatibility shim for JSON schema v1 for 30 days, auto-delete after no requests. we can instrument that via the router.

alex: agreed. timeline: spike next week, full rollouts over 3 weeks, retro + metrics audit after.

maya: :thumbsup: i can take retro notes. minor nit: add canary rollback automation so it's one-click.

sam: ack — I'll add a script. starting PRs now.

alex: thanks team — will write up RFC follow-up and list owners. tagging @maya @sam @jon for action items.
